mapper.sql: report_id, report_date, content, market_condition, report_status, generation_source, model_name, prompt_version, valid_from, valid_until, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_market_report ( report_date, content, market_condition, report_status, generation_source, model_name, prompt_version, valid_from, valid_until ) VALUES ( #{reportDate}, #{content}, #{marketCondition}, #{reportStatus}, #{generationSource}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(report_id), content = VALUES(content), market_condition = VALUES(market_condition), report_status = VALUES(report_status), generation_source = VALUES(generation_source), model_name = VALUES(model_name), prompt_version = VALUES(prompt_version), valid_from = VALUES(valid_from), valid_until = VALUES(valid_until)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM daily_market_report ORDER BY report_date DESC LIMIT 1
